Change FWID RPCs to no longer take (str | tuple) Previously, several RPCs were able to take EITHER a string (representing a FW section) OR a tuple of strings (each representing a FW section). The return value would also vary based on what the input type was. Those RPCs were: bios.get_fwid, ec.get_fwid, updater.get_fwid, updater.get_installed_fwid, updater.modify_fwid. With this change, each RPC arg has a well-defined type for all methods. In place of the above RPCs, we now have: updater.get_section_fwid, updater.get_all_fwids, updater.get_all_installed_fwids, and updater.modify_fwids. BUG=chromium:963160 TEST=1. test_that firmware_FAFTRPC.ec firmware_FAFTRPC.bios firmware_FAFTRPC.updater firmware_UpdateFirmwareDataKeyVersion firmware_UpdateFirmwareVersion firmware_UpdateKernelSubkeyVersion 2. Compile the protobuf via: `python -m grpc_tools.protoc --proto_path=client/cros/faft/proto/ --python_out=client/cros/faft/proto --grpc_python_out=client/cros/faft/proto client/cros/faft/proto/rpc_functions.proto` Change-Id: I710839f2a309098b81dfb546a6e667ab82cac9bb Signed-off-by: Greg Edelston <gredelston@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1658661 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org>
